profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nordstrom
profile.summary:
3 years developing end to end native iOS applications. Strong work ethic built on solid development training with a keen understanding of Swift, iOS Architecture, and Cocoa Touch.

Here is what I'm good at:
- Building and shipping apps in Swift and Objective-C. I have shipped 4 apps as a professional developer.
- Xcode, Git, Github, BitBucket, CocoaPods, Sketch, Photoshop.
- Cocoa Touch Framework. I have significant experience with UIKit, Foundation, AVFoundation, and CoreData. I know how to leverage Cocoa Touch for best performance.
- Clean architecture design patterns like single responsibility, dependency injection and MVVM
- Constructing API layers to consume RESTful web services
- Unit Testing using XCTestCase
- Following Behavior Driven Development practices by utilizing Calabash, Cucumber, Ruby and Gherkin
- Using PromiseKit to make asynchronous code cleaner and easier to work with
- Facebook SDK, Fabric SDK, Mixpanel SDK, Reachability SDK, Stripe SDK, Branch.io SDK, Kickflip SDK, FFmpeg
- Building UI using interface builder, autolayout, storyboards, xibs, and programmatic layout
- Push notifications and deep linking
- UI/UX Design. I love working with designers on how to build UI for the best user experience.
- Agile workflow utilizing JIRA to build sprints, manage backlogs, participate in stand ups and sprint planning meetings
- Public speaking

positions.description:
- Provide critical analytics to general contractors during the construction of new restaurants

positions.description:

positions.description:

- Worked with director, lightning technician, rigging technician, and stage crew to perform over  100 shows successfully, which brought in new clients for the district
- Implemented new workflow procedures for handling microphones and signal flow

volunteerExperiences.description:
- In charge of operating the live feed mixing board
- Follow a play-by-play schedule down to the minute, includes song lists, cues for transitions, and video announcements
- Coordinate with pastor, band members, lighting, camera, lyric, powerpoint, and front of house technicians to run a successful service three times back to back sunday mornings.

projects.title: Weple - iOS App
projects.description:
-	Users can broadcast live video to friends or groups straight from their iPhone
-	Built in Objective-C and shipped to the App Store in 4 months
-	Designed, coded, and tested the 15+ screens users see while in the app
-	Technologies used include Objective C, FFmpeg, AVFoundation, and HTTP Live Streaming

projects.title: BuildIt - iOS App
projects.description:
-	Tracks, manages, and reports expenses for commercial construction projects
-	Solo project, built and shipped privately in 287 hours
-	Currently in use for the construction of The Lodge Sports Grille restaurants
-	Data syncing across all devices using Parse Framework
